name: Dimitris Tsiodras, Piotr Müller - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 1272/2008, (EC) No 1223/2009 and (EU) 2019/1009 as regards simplification of certain requirements and procedures for chemical products
part_text:
Parliament wants to make three sets of chemical rules simpler to follow without lowering protection of health, consumers and the environment. For hazardous chemicals, labels would carry an online contact point, small packages and ink cartridges get lighter labelling, and adverts aimed at the public must still warn of hazards. For cosmetics, the rules on banned substances and on ingredient names are clarified, and online sellers must show label information. For fertilisers, paperwork moves online and more micro-organisms could be approved faster.

- Hazardous chemicals: labels get an online contact, small packs and ink cartridges need less, adverts keep a warning.
- Cosmetics: clearer rules on banned substances, ingredient names, and label information shown in online sales.
- Fertilisers: digital paperwork, faster approval of micro-organisms; Parliament now negotiates the final text with EU governments.
